newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela capital markets issuance up 37 pct in yr.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela capital markets issuance up 37 pct in yr.

text.p: The issue of Venezuelan securities is up 37 percent over the first eight months of 1996 compared to the same period last year, Venezuela's National Securities Commission (CNV) said.

Between January and August the total value of securities issued reached 187 billion bolivars ($397 million) compared to 136 billion bolivars ($289 million) last year, CNV president Aida Lamus told a news conference.

Of the 187 billion bolivar total, over 100 billion bolivars worth of shares were issued, 11 percent up from last year's total, 69 billion bolivars worth of commercial paper was issued, a 113 percent increase over last year's level, and 15.5 billion bolivars worth of debentures, up 29 percent.
